We appreciate your patience and look forward to helping you!

data.content: # Modmail Toolbox
-# Commands to use in modmail
**!d <message>** - Sends a message to the user hiding the staff members name.
**!ex <message>** - Sends a message to the user exposing the staff members name
**!ping** - Get pinged when the user sends a message in this ticket.
**!tb** - Send a list of available commands to use in this post.
